frozen_platform_vs_architecture.M12_native_delta_policy: Unsealed native policy is not an approved extra exception. No compiler_contract, grammar, catalog, serializer, selection, literal, prompt, DSL, status or diagnostic exception follows from this join.
frozen_platform_vs_architecture.architectural_requirement: No model, weights, MLX, training or Apple Silicon requirement for deterministic CNL to DSL to Code.
frozen_platform_vs_architecture.forbidden_inference: Same version text, a passing fixture, or a source build alone does not satisfy frozen binary/toolchain identity or product gates.
frozen_platform_vs_architecture.historical_role: Preserve exact historical tool and host hashes as evidence of what ran then.
frozen_platform_vs_architecture.portable_native_role: A reviewed numbered native tool extension must bind native binary versions and SHA256, source/license, complete offline dependencies, paths, commands and descriptor deltas.

must_be_observed_for_M12_current_candida: Compiler binary and package identity, all descriptors, source pins and full runtime ownership/cleanup.
Complete actual offline dependency closure and all full build/test/format/clippy/quality/behavior gates in M12 scope.
Any React/TypeScript regression claim required by the current M12 gate must bind the current candidate; prior M6 current-side output cannot be relabelled.
Independent audit of every applicable frozen row from original raw output.
not_reusable_as_current_pass: M6 macOS binary/tool hashes as Linux binary hashes.
M6 passing product/behavior results as M12 current product results.
M6 tooling fixtures as M12 product acceptance.
An aggregate success or source-only preparation as missing named-tool execution.
reusable_before_authority: Immutable original recorded historical request/reply and per-file hashes.
Separate source-reconstructed request hashes with derived authority retained.
Fresh M6 before captured requests/replies and product hashes, with exact fresh role and source/run pins.
Sealed contracts and independent reviews whose bytes remain exact.
reusable_historical_completion: The accepted M6 receipt remains evidence for its recorded candidate59dab78a and source40cffc13. It grants no M12 binary or platform acceptance.

review_kind: source and public receipt metadata only
